sn55.49:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme. atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. …pe…
sn55.49:1.2: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho mahānāmaṃ sakkaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
sn55.49:1.3: “catūhi kho mahānāma, dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipāta dhammo niyato sambodhiparāyano.
sn55.49:2.2: idha mahānāma, ariyasāvako buddhe aveccappasādena samannāgato hoti: “itipi so bhagavā …pe… satthā devamanussānaṃ buddho bhagavā”ti.
sn55.49:2.5: ariyakantehi sīlehi samannāgato hoti akhaṇḍehi …pe… samādhisaṃvattanikehi.
sn55.49:2.6: imehi kho mahānāma, catūhi dhammehi samannāgato ariyasāvako sotāpanno hoti avinipātadhammo niyato sambodhiparāyanoti.
